featured_reviews.name: Brian D'Souza
featured_reviews.review_text:
The store has a nice variety of pens and stationery, but the service is very disappointing. There are too many sales people behind the counter, yet they spend more time chit-chatting with each other instead of attending to customers.

I have shopped here multiple times, but during my recent visit, I asked for a discount since I was purchasing multiple items. One sales person rudely said “nahi milega.” When I said there was no need to be rude, the main person at the cashier table said, “lena hai toh lo, timepass mat karo.”

That was enough for me, I left immediately and will never return.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Dear Brian D'Souza
We’re truly sorry to hear about your disappointing experience at our store. What you described is unacceptable, and we apologize for the rude behavior of our staff. Your feedback has been shared with the team, and necessary action will be taken to ensure better service in the future.

We value your support and hope you’ll give us another chance to make things right.

Thank you for bringing this to our attention.

              **[VARIETY BOOK CANTRE AND STATIONERY]**

featured_reviews.name: Ashish Tiwari
featured_reviews.review_text:
Came from Andheri for the book. Couldn’t find it anywhere else. All CBSE ICSE Maharashtra Board books are available here. Very helpful staff. Spoke to us politely and guided us well.
Well santized and hygienic.
Best shop in Vasai Virar area.

featured_reviews.review_text: Prime Book Centre is an absolute gem! 📚 I always find what I'm looking for. Definitely my go-to spot for books. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.review_text: Great book store for CBSE and ICSE books. I wanted preparation books for UPSC exam all the NCERT required were available here. Very courteous and generous staff
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you so much for your positive feedback

featured_reviews.name: Vibrant Life Preeti
featured_reviews.review_text: Well informed Business Owner. Good knowledge of the syllabus and latest policies in the education field.

featured_reviews.name: Shivam Dubey
featured_reviews.review_text: So i had visited this book store recently to buy some novels and some comptative exam preparation books. It was really great that the book seller had a great knowledge related to the books and subject. He helped me out to find good book. I haven't found any single book store in vasai virar region with this much varaities and knowledge. Its a must visiting store great ambiance and great collection of books. One can even order book and they will arrange the book asap. Happy to find such book store near my house.

featured_reviews.name: Shubham Dubey
featured_reviews.review_text: Need a book go to prime book centre you'll get it. If they don't have they'll provide on the next day. Excellent service and wide range of books available for CBSE and ICSE books. Very polite and well attending staff.
